contract_gaps.tenant_selection: Every organisation API call requires Xero-tenant-id. The connection substrate does not synthesize a post-OAuth tenant header, so tenant ID remains an explicit required, approval-bound operation argument discovered through xero-identity.get_connections.
contract_gaps.binary_uploads: Twenty-two Accounting attachment uploads require application/octet-stream and two Files uploads require multipart/form-data. The current adapter emits JSON, urlencoded scalar forms, or text body_raw only, so all 24 are excluded rather than serialized incorrectly.
contract_gaps.binary_downloads: Accounting attachments/PDFs and Files content are admitted only through response_capture file_ref isolation with the 64 MiB runtime cap; raw bytes never enter recipe values.
contract_gaps.app_store_auth: marketplace.billing is currently documented as a non-tenanted client-credentials scope. The app-store leaf therefore uses a separate manually managed bearer connection and is not a dependency of xero.
contract_gaps.webhook_direction: xero-webhooks.yaml is an inbound OpenAPI 3.1 webhooks contract with zero outbound paths. It is pinned and audited but cannot truthfully produce a callable REST composition row.
contract_gaps.oauth_scopes: Read operations choose documented .read scopes when Xero lists both read-write and read-only alternatives. Every ordinary Xero operation also declares openid, profile, email, and offline_access because the enrolled oauth2_refresh connection requires user identity read-back and a refresh token.
contract_gaps.pagination: Fifty-two single-array query page contracts use the bounded offset walker with page-number increment and empty-page termination; their page and pageSize arguments are gateway-owned. Payroll AU getPayItems is the deliberate exception: its page applies to four parallel arrays inside PayItems, which the one-result-path walker cannot merge honestly, so that operation retains an explicit caller page argument. The current official Accounting paging guide supplies the 1000-record pageSize ceiling omitted by the generated OpenAPI component.
contract_gaps.json_array_bodies: Fifteen Payroll mutations document a root JSON array, which the object-composing adapter cannot synthesize from body.* fields. They use approval-bound literal body_raw JSON; their operation descriptions require callers to omit the server-owned readOnly fields enumerated by this fixture.
contract_gaps.query_collections: Thirteen list-valued query parameters are emitted as bounded comma-separated string arguments because the REST adapter supports one value per query key. This preserves Xero wire behavior without making read request schemas fail-open for array-typed arguments.
contract_gaps.legacy_pack: The pre-existing accounting-xero pack is a narrow canonical accounting compatibility surface. This generated suite uses distinct leaf slugs and does not replace or mutate it.

source_decision.reason: No supported task, note, or project candidate has both a mandatory stable identity and a mandatory version field across the pinned list/read response contracts.

candidates_rejected.reason: The Project schema requires only name; projectId is optional and the schema declares no updated-at, revision, or other mandatory version field.
A file is not truthfully a note, and the FileObject required array names fields that do not match the actual response property casing, so it cannot prove mandatory identity/version presence.
Payroll records are region-specific sensitive workforce data and the pinned response contracts do not require both identity and updatedDateUTC on every list item.
